text_block_list.text: It's time for the Sapporo Kinen, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Hm? There's a decorative tree over in
the
corner...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
The name has a nice ring to it and all,
but what's
it doing here?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it says here that the lilac is the
official tree of
Sapporo.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Ooh! This is a very auspicious omen!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: What are the chances that this lilac would be blooming now?! Lilac has the same amount of letters as "lucky", and they both start with l. This has to mean something!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
O great gods of the north, I humbly
accept this
blessing.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Grant us good fortune. And, if possible,
some of
that famous Sapporo lamb
barbecue too.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
